collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — ROLE MODELS AND GOOD EXAMPLES, RM-41 to RM-90 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more events continuing your "Role Models and Good Examples — 40 Events". Same shape as yours: a SETUP, choices A-D (a few have three), and two possible outcomes per choice; the game picks one outcome from the chosen choice.

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: A child asks a young builder why roofs on Isola slope the way they do, and the builder realizes they do not actually know.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A child asks (name1), a young builder, why roofs on Isola slope the way they do, and the builder realizes they do not actually know.

choices.label: Make a Guess and Say It Is a Guess.
Build Two Small Roofs and Test Them.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The child seems delighted that grown-ups do not know everything.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The child is a little disappointed but asks something else instead.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: An elder builder explains how rain runs off steep thatch, and both listen closely.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The elder gives three different reasons, and the builder and child argue happily about which is right.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The guess turns out to be close, and the child remembers it.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The guess is wrong, and the builder learns the truth from the child a few days later.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: Water runs off the steep model and pools on the flat one, and the answer is plain to see.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: Both models collapse in the first shower, and the experiment becomes a fond joke.

text_only.reason: a small thing breaks in the story; no building is damaged -- story only: the file marks no effect (no new mechanics)
